hook: 39 kW down and 238 kg lighter. Featherweight roadster vs the bigger-engined coupe. Only 0.2 s apart.

stories.a: Roof off, under 1,100 kg. The purist's pick since 1989.
stories.b: More power, more torque, back seats and a fixed roof for less money.
stories.take: Spec sheet says Toyota. Your heart might say Mazda.

_sources: WhichCar '2023 Toyota GR86 v Mazda MX-5 review' comparison specs: GR86 GTS manual 2387cc flat-four 174 kW / 250 Nm, 1291 kg, 0-100 6.3 s claimed, 4 seats, $45,390 +ORC; MX-5 GT SP manual 1998cc 135 kW / 205 Nm, 1053 kg, 0-100 6.5 s claimed, 2 seats, $47,320 +ORC; MX-5 238 kg lighter
